note: Registered before the holdout was scored. theta values are selected on validation seasons only, then frozen.

strategies.name: Model edge vs closing spread
strategies.rule: Bet the side where the model's home margin disagrees with the market's implied home margin by >= theta points.
strategies.gate_notes: G7 passes only for seasons with archived closing lines.

strategies.name: Model edge vs closing total
strategies.rule: Bet over/under where the model total disagrees with the closing total by >= theta points.

strategies.name: Moneyline value
strategies.rule: Bet the moneyline when model win probability exceeds the vig-free market implied probability by >= theta.
strategies.gate_notes: Requires both moneylines archived; otherwise the game is skipped, never imputed.

strategies.name: 2-leg cross-game parlay
strategies.rule: Combine two S1 selections from different games in the same week.
strategies.pricing: ASSUMED standard 2-team payout 2.64 (+164); flagged, because sportsbook parlay pricing is not archived.
strategies.gate_notes: G7 FAILS: payout is an assumption, not an archived price. Research-only by construction.

strategies.name: Favourite-cover + under SGP
strategies.rule: Compare the empirical joint probability of (favourite covers) AND (under hits) with the product of their marginals to size the dependence correction.
strategies.pricing: No archived SGP price; fair-price monitor only.
strategies.gate_notes: G7 FAILS: no verified SGP price. Produces a correlation value, not a bet.

strategies.name: Player prop single
strategies.rule: Over/under on a player stat versus a model line built from that player's prior games.
strategies.pricing: No authorized 2026 player-level feed and no archived prop prices in scope.
strategies.gate_notes: BLOCKED. No values published; see Open Question Q-07.

strategies.name: Same-game prop combo
strategies.rule: Joint probability of two correlated player legs vs the product of marginals.
strategies.pricing: No archived prop or combo prices.
